Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in data interpretation during the analysis of the Niyoti release dates. In the previous turn, the Planner correctly identified that Niyoti had an early "scheduled" date of April 8, 2016, and an India release of June 10, 2016. However, in Step 6, the Planner incorrectly re-interpreted the information, stating that "Niyoti has an official release date of 24 June 2016... which is later than Angali Pangali's 17 June 2016." This contradicts the earlier finding that the film released in India on June 10, 2016 (which is earlier than June 17). The Planner failed to distinguish between "scheduled" dates and "actual release" dates, and incorrectly prioritized a later date (June 24) over the earlier actual release date (June 10), leading to the wrong conclusion that Angali Pangali came out first.
